role: Core domain types for the Co-Being knowledge graph (Layer 3).
detail: Defines SchemaLevel enum (INSTANCE, SCHEMA, META_SCHEMA) for the three-tier knowledge graph structure. NodeStatus enum (ACTIVE, SUPERSEDED, PENDING, REJECTED) governs node lifecycle transitions. KnowledgeNode is a mutable Pydantic model representing graph nodes with immutable provenance; carries node_id, node_type, schema_level, properties dict, confidence (0.0-1.0), status, timestamps (created_at, valid_from, valid_to, last_confirmed), and counters (confirmation_count, prediction_errors). KnowledgeEdge is a mutable directed relationship model with edge_id, source_id, target_id, edge_type, properties, provenance, confidence, and temporal validity. Both use validate_assignment=True but are not frozen, allowing confidence/status/temporal fields to evolve. Provenance metadata enforces CANON A.11 immutability at the object level while node/edge references to it can change (e.g., inference approval).
gotchas: No stubs or TODOs. Provenance is immutable on the object but the node can be reassigned a new Provenance instance at runtime. Node fields like confidence, status, valid_to, last_confirmed, confirmation_count, and prediction_errors are mutable and change over the node's lifetime. predict_errors counter is explicitly for PREDICTION_ERROR_DEMOTION gate logic (CANON A.2).
